India's Banking System Liquidity Surplus Reaches 4.5-Year High

India's banking system has recorded a liquidity surplus of over Rs 7.76 lakh crore, marking a high not seen in more than 4.5 years. This surge in surplus liquidity indicates a significant amount of funds available within the banking sector. The figures reflect the current financial conditions and the amount of money circulating within the Indian banking system.
